**Finding submitted: TRANSITION — missing (confidence 0.85).**

- **Investigation:** § 3.5 (Effect of Termination) covers only accrued charges; § 3.4 imposes continued IBM performance only up to the termination date; § 11.6 makes Customer responsible for Content; § 14.18 addresses processing instructions only; § 14.2 survival lists § 3.5 but there is no substantive exit obligation to survive. Targeted searches for transition, return, delete, export and expiration produced no responsive clause.
- **Action:** Inserted a single new paragraph in § 3.5 at the **preferred** level — up to six months' transition assistance at IBM's then-current rates, return of all Content within 30 days in a standard machine-readable format, and certified deletion after that return — using the document's defined term "Content" to avoid an undefined "Customer Data" reference. Fallback (90 days / 30-day export) offered in the comment.
